text: BrennanAG is built and healthy, but nobody's watching it on a schedule yet. This video closes that gap -- real monitoring for the Availability Group and the jobs underneath it.

Two checks matter most: replica health every five minutes, and the log send and redo queues on BrennanERP, which predict real data-loss exposure. A dbatools script also checks every backup job on both nodes and alerts the moment one fails.
A growing log send queue means the secondary is falling behind right now -- catching that early is the whole point of checking every five minutes instead of glancing occasionally.
Same week, a routine ticket: a new standalone database, ProductionSchedulingDB, for the scheduling team's module. Created correctly -- joining it to BrennanAG is a separate step, scheduled for later.
The Availability Group now watches itself. Next: the same DBA discipline, applied to a database that isn't SQL Server at all.
